title: Explanatory Model Monitoring to Understand the Effects of Feature Shifts on Performance

problem.claim: Maintaining and monitoring machine learning models is critical for translating advances into real-world applications.

gap.claim: Existing monitoring methods do not provide actionable explanations for why a particular model's performance degraded.

contributions.claim: A method explains black-box model behavior under feature shifts by attributing estimated performance changes to interpretable input characteristics.
The method, called Explanatory Performance Estimation, combines Optimal Transport and Shapley Values.
The approach supports explanatory model monitoring by identifying potential root causes of model deterioration and guiding actionable countermeasures.

stated_novelty.claim: The authors explicitly present their approach for explaining black-box model behavior under feature shifts as novel.

author_reported_evidence.claim: The authors report analyzing the method's underlying assumptions.
The authors report that their approach outperforms several baselines across different datasets and image, audio, and tabular modalities.
The authors report that the generated explanations can reveal potential root causes and guide actionable countermeasures.

narrative_sequence.summary: Model monitoring and maintenance are important for real-world machine learning applications.
Current monitoring methods lack actionable explanations for performance degradation.
The proposed approach attributes estimated performance changes under feature shifts to interpretable input characteristics and combines Optimal Transport with Shapley Values.
The authors report assumption analysis and superiority over several baselines across multiple datasets and modalities.
The approach is intended to support root-cause analysis and actionable responses to model deterioration.

source_observation.claim: The method attributes estimated performance changes to interpretable input characteristics under feature shifts.

interpretation.claim: Monitoring becomes more actionable when performance change is connected to interpretable characteristics rather than reported only as a metric deviation.

application.claim: Use feature-shift monitoring that links observed performance changes to interpretable inputs and candidate root causes.

exception.claim: The abstract does not establish when the approach's assumptions may fail or when its explanations may be insufficient.

unknowns: The abstract does not specify the datasets, baselines, or quantitative performance results.
The abstract does not detail the method's assumptions or their empirical analysis.
The abstract does not provide implementation, computational, or reproducibility details.
